title: Barre Studio — Current Room
summary: The current barre studio and Repair Shop home, including the decision to retain and refinish an original solid-wood door.
searchSummary: Current barre studio evidence from the Home Reno - Studio | Office Flickr album, kept separate from the future studio renovation.
stage: Current barre studio; the move has not occurred

gallery.caption: The stripped original door installed before its separate charred-finish treatment.
The retained wood door within its painted surround.

introduction: This room remains the current home of the barre studio and Repair Shop. Alongside the room views, selected details follow the choice to keep an original solid-wood door and work its charred surface by hand.
evidenceBoundary: The installed stripped-door photo predates the separate charred-finish treatment. These details do not establish that the finished door was reinstalled. The journal's 2022 heading conflicts with mostly February 2023 Flickr date labels, so the work is not presented as a dated sequence. This is the current studio, not the dedicated Office or future studio.
